final_template:
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role for cross-account access"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the principal allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external_id" {
  description = "External ID for the assume role trust condition"
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote_arn]
    }
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external_id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_role" {
  name               = var.rolename
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_custom_policy_document" {
  # Statement 1: Read-only access across multiple services
  statement {
    sid    = "WizReadOnlyAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "acm:Describe*",
      "acm:List*",
      "apigateway:GET",
      "backup:Describe*",
      "backup:Get*",
      "backup:List*",
      "cloudtrail:Describe*",
      "cloudtrail:Get*",
      "cloudtrail:List*",
      "cloudtrail:LookupEvents",
      "codebuild:List*",
      "codebuild:Describe*",
      "cognito-identity:Describe*",
      "cognito-identity:List*",
      "connect:Describe*",
      "connect:List*",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:Get*",
      "dynamodb:List*",
      "dynamodb:Query",
      "dynamodb:Scan",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ecr:Describe*",
      "ecr:List*",
      "eks:Describe*",
      "eks:List*",
      "elasticfilesystem:Describe*",
      "elasticfilesystem:List*",
      "elasticmapreduce:Describe*",
      "elasticmapreduce:List*",
      "glacier:Describe*",
      "glacier:Get*",
      "glacier:List*",
      "glue:Get*",
      "glue:List*",
      "health:Describe*",
      "kafka:Describe*",
      "kafka:List*",
      "kendra:Describe*",
      "kendra:List*",
      "kinesisanalytics:Describe*",
      "kinesisanalytics:List*",
      "kinesisvideo:Describe*",
      "kinesisvideo:List*",
      "kms:Describe*",
      "kms:Get*",
      "kms:List*",
      "lambda:Get*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "logs:Describe*",
      "logs:Get*",
      "logs:List*",
      "profile:Get*",
      "profile:List*",
      "s3:Get*",
      "s3:List*",
      "ses:Describe*",
      "ses:Get*",
      "ses:List*",
      "voiceid:Describe*",
      "voiceid:List*",
      "wafv2:Describe*",
      "wafv2:Get*",
      "wafv2:List*",
      "wisdom:Describe*",
      "wisdom:Get*",
      "wisdom:List*",
      "macie2:Describe*",
      "macie2:Get*",
      "macie2:List*",
      "identitystore:Describe*",
      "identitystore:List*",
      "sso-directory:Describe*",
      "sso-directory:List*",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Get*",
      "cloudwatch:List*",
      "ssm:Describe*",
      "ssm:Get*",
      "ssm:List*"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Statement 2: EBS snapshot creation and metadata retrieval
  statement {
    sid    = "WizEbsSnapshotActions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Statement 3: Tag creation on EC2 snapshots in any region
  statement {
    sid    = "WizCreateTagsOnSnapshots"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateTags"
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/*"]
  }

  # Statement 4: KMS alias creation on "wizKey" alias and on any KMS key
  statement {
    sid    = "WizKmsAliasCreation"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:CreateAlias"
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*"
    ]
  }

  # Statement 5: KMS key policy actions with resource tag condition
  statement {
    sid    = "WizKmsKeyPolicyActions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 6: Snapshot deletion and modification with EC2 resource tag condition
  statement {
    sid    = "WizSnapshotDeletionModification"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:ResetSnapshotAttribute"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 7: Explicit Deny for s3:GetObject
  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessS3"
    effect = "Deny"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "wiz_custom_policy" {
  name        = "WizCustomPolicy"
  description = "Custom policy for Wiz cross-account security auditing"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_custom_policy_document.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "wiz_custom_policy_attachment" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.wiz_custom_policy.arn
}

terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

# Variables
variable "username" {
  description = "IAM user name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my_vpn_infra_user"
}

variable "group_name" {
  description = "IAM group name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-infra-group"
}

variable "membership_name" {
  description = "Group membership name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-infra-manager-group"
}

variable "project_tag" {
  description = "Value for the ProjectTag tag"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-tag"
}

variable "policy_path" {
  description = "Path for IAM policies"
  type        = string
  default     = "/my_vpn_infra/"
}

# IAM User
resource "aws_iam_user" "infra_user" {
  name          = var.username
  force_destroy = true
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

# IAM Group
resource "aws_iam_group" "infra_group" {
  name = var.group_name
}

# Group Membership
resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "infra_group_membership" {
  name  = var.membership_name
  users = [aws_iam_user.infra_user.name]
  group = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
}

# Access Key
resource "aws_iam_access_key" "infra_user_key" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.infra_user.name
  status = "Active"
}

# Policy Documents
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "basic_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}
